dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: A guard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this a warehouse?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess I'll leave you to it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look like a guard...

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Nobody's born looking like one.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Nothing to see here. Move along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's in the warehouse?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Confidential.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Nothing to see here. Move along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like there's much going on around here...

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: ...Exactly. Nothing is going on, ever has gone on, or ever will go on, around here — now move along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How've you been, Mr. Chicherin?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Everything's well, thank you for asking.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: It's just... as usual, I sometimes dream of Sigurd.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: If it becomes too painful, I could find a way for you to forget those memories.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: I appreciate the thought. But until Sigurd rests in peace, or death takes me first, I have no intention of forgetting anything.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: I will find him. I will put him to rest. And if you worry that I might sell my power to those treasure hunters because of this... no, I promise you, I would never do such a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I do so hope so. In that case, I'll take my leave. I wish you peace and joy in your waveless endeavors, Mr. Chicherin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How's life been treating you recently, Mr. Chicherin?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking, Lady Nefer. Life's been ticking along as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Good to hear — "as usual" is the best we can ask for.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I wish you all the best, Mr. Chicherin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: How've you been, Mr. Chicherin?

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: If you're here with a message from Lady Nefer, save the pleasantries and just say it. I can't stand watching you Seahook Gang types put on that little act of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: How dare you...! Say that name once more, and I'll tear your mouth apart and break your limbs! Then I'll tie a couple of rocks to your feet and throw you into the sea to feed the fish!

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Yes, now that sounds more like you people. Certainly sounds more like you, and Zinaida too.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Seethes) Boss Nef told me I couldn't touch you if you behaved... otherwise I would've already done it... I would've!

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. Let's just get down to business, young lady. What does Lady Nefer want me to do?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hmph. You old geezer... Boss Nef sent me with a message. She says to tell you that she's found that clue you've been chasing, and in return, she wants your help dealing with the Wild Hunt on the east side of Paha Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Chicherin
dialogues.text: I understand. Thank Lady Nefer for me, and please let her know that I'm accepting this commission.
